meta.source: AMP-AD brain proteome, LFQ (AD vs control, 4 regions) — Agora / Synapse syn18689335
meta.units: log2 fold change, AD vs control, per brain region
meta.p_is: Cor_PVal — FDR-corrected. Raw p kept as p_raw.
meta.tissue_policy: DLPFC when measured, otherwise the region with the smallest corrected p; every region kept under tissues{}
meta.isoform_policy: per gene and region, the UniProt isoform with the smallest corrected p (Agora convention)
meta.scale_note: AD brain effect sizes are ~20x smaller than tumour-vs-normal. |log2FC| q95 across genes is 0.28, q99 0.51; the axis divisor for this cohort is set in disease_registry.json (log2fc_scale), not the cancer default of 3.
